besluite.fout: The pronoun 'sy' first appears two sentences after 'n Juwelier', following a general statement about rings, so the reader has to look back to find who is meant.
besluite.rede: Naming the jeweller again re-anchors the actor without changing the meaning, and the following 'Sy poleer' then reads cleanly.

besluite.fout: 'Diep grawe' can be read as 'deep spades' (plural of graaf), which is plausible in a list of costs.
besluite.rede: The ambiguity is real, but the proposed infinitive clause breaks the noun-phrase pattern of the other list items and lengthens the item, so the writer should choose the fix.
